verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is documented as a double-entry accounting system, and journal entries exist in the product: Command can write them for the user. There is no explicit documentation that an accountant can manually post entries, that debits and credits must balance, or that entries carry supporting memos. missing for 10: documented manual journal entry posting workflow, explicit balanced debit/credit enforcement, supporting memo/attachment fields on journal entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: Offload work like writing journal entries, organizing your chart of accounts, categorization in bulk, and more.
Double-entry accounting that pulls directly from your Mercury data
